title: Dynamic Task Planner v0.4c
description: Typed plans for validate, dry_run, and isolated test modes. No execution-capable fields are permitted.
$comment: search_knowledge uses query/limit/save_as(search_results); extract_number uses from/field/source/patterns/save_as(number), with one optional bounded refine_query/refine_limit fallback for missing evidence only; calculate uses an approved arithmetic operation and two numeric operands; write_report paths are under output/ or temp/ and placeholders are simple numeric variables or extracted fact fields; verify_file requires a dependent write_report reference for the same path.
x-security: Only the fixed isolated knowledge-service endpoint is available in test mode.
Bearer credentials are read from a file and never returned or logged.
validate and dry_run perform no retrieval, writes, subprocesses, or production access.
test mode performs read-only isolated retrieval and keeps reports in memory.
